canonical_source.behavior: Export the currently retained authoritative Site Operations rows to CSV, disable export when no matching retained rows exist, and report download startup failures without fake success.

laravel_adaptation.tenant_isolation: auth + tenant.context + TenantAuthorizer plus tenant global scope on SiteOperationHistory and Site relation
laravel_adaptation.retained_history_scope: The Laravel route reads up to 2000 retained authoritative rows, matching the canonical retained history limit.
laravel_adaptation.empty_state: Export button is disabled when the authoritative row set is empty.
laravel_adaptation.error_state: Browser download startup failure renders an alert and does not report success.

security_boundary.tenant_context: tenant.context resolves active membership and rejects foreign tenant route access
security_boundary.caller_supplied_tenant_selector: route tenant must match authenticated active TenantContext
security_boundary.secret_non_exposure: CSV is built only from the server-returned SiteOperationHistory fields; no credentials or connector secrets are queried or synthesized

terminality.basis: The canonical ExportCsvAsync control is wired to real tenant-scoped retained Site Operations data, produces a real browser CSV download from those authoritative rows, fails closed for empty/unauthorized/foreign-tenant reads, and never fabricates success.

scope_exclusions: No adjacent Site Operations filter or reset operations are claimed
No payment provider readiness is fabricated
